name: kokpit
description: A band above the prompt (context, usage limits, task progress, background jobs, decisions), handoffs to thread files instead of compaction, a decision register, background jobs, Economy (subagent models and effort matched to the task), workshop skills and a repo-standard setup.

handoffMode.title: Handoff mode
handoffMode.description: button = only a button in the band; break = by itself at the end of a turn after a finished task (whole list checked off, no question pending), and from the hard threshold at the end of the next turn; auto = by itself at the end of the first turn after the threshold that does not end with a question. At most one automatic handoff per conversation.

handoffTokens.title: Handoff threshold (soft, context tokens)
handoffTokens.description: From how many context tokens a handoff is offered, or done after a finished task. Never later than 75% of the model window.

handoffHardTokens.title: Hard handoff threshold (context tokens)
handoffHardTokens.description: From how many tokens a handoff starts at the end of a turn even mid-work or after a question. 0 = soft threshold + 100,000; never beyond 85% of the window.

handoffClear.title: Clearing after a handoff
handoffClear.description: message = after the thread is saved, your next message clears the conversation, resumes the thread and goes to the new session together with the last two answers (also saved in .claude/kokpit/previous/); button = only "Clear and resume".

taskNudge.title: Ask Claude for a task list
taskNudge.description: Adds a short request to the system prompt to keep a task list for multi-step work, so the band can show progress.

decisionsFile.title: Decision register file
decisionsFile.description: Path relative to the project where Claude appends decisions to confirm and the /decisions pane writes rulings. Empty = docs/decisions.md (or an existing docs/decyzje.md).

language.title: Language of generated files
language.description: Language of new handoff threads, decision-register entries and repo-standard templates. Existing files keep their language. The interface is in English.
